tier1.text: The manubrium forms joints with the clavicles, or collarbones, and the first ribs attach to it. It is the wide top part of the sternum, or breastbone. The manubrium's top edge has a shallow notch you can feel at the base of the neck. The manubrium meets the long middle part of the sternum at a slight bend.

sentences.text: The manubrium forms joints with the clavicles, or collarbones, and the first ribs attach to it.

quotes.quote: The manubrium forms the expanded, superior end of the sternum. It has a jugular (suprasternal) notch, a pair of clavicular notches for articulation with the clavicles, and receives the costal cartilage of the first rib.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: clavicle: collarbone; elongated bone that articulates with the manubrium of the sternum medially and the acromion of the scapula laterally
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: It is the wide top part of the sternum, or breastbone.

quotes.quote: The manubrium is the wider, superior portion of the sternum.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: sternum: (also, breastbone) long, flat bone located at the front of the chest
quotes.citation: Clark MA, Douglas M, Choi J (2018). Biology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The manubrium's top edge has a shallow notch you can feel at the base of the neck.

quotes.quote: The top of the manubrium has a shallow, U-shaped border called the jugular (suprasternal) notch. This can be easily felt at the anterior base of the neck, between the medial ends of the clavicles.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The manubrium meets the long middle part of the sternum at a slight bend.

quotes.quote: The elongated, central portion of the sternum is the body. The manubrium and body join together at the sternal angle, so called because the junction between these two components is not flat, but forms a slight bend.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.
